 1. Ali wants to perform fajr prayer. One Surah that must be recited in the prayer is
 ………………………………………………………………..
 2. Muslims learn from Surah Al-Kafirun that they should
 …………………………………………………………………………………………….
 (ask for forgiveness from Allah, seek protection from Allah, believe in only one God)
 3. Before going to bed, Rahma a Grade 4 learner recited Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An - Nas so
 that she could
 ……………………………………………………………………………………………..
 (ask for forgiveness from Allah, seek protection from Allah, Praise Allah)
 4. The Surah that teaches Muslims that bad people will be punished is Surah ………………
 5. The Surah that you could refer to when reminding your classmate that victory and success come
 from seeking guidance from Allah in times need is Surah …………………………
 (Al- Masad, An- Nasr, Al- Ikhlas)
 6. The Surah that teaches Muslims to depend on Allah only is Surah …………………………….
 (Al – Falaq, An – Nas, Al- Ikhlas)
 7. Complete the following Hadith of the Prophet (P.b.u.h).
 “Teach your children swimming, archery and …………………………………
 8. While taking lunch, you observed the following from four of your classmates:
 Khalid – was eating food that was hot
 Khadija – said Bismillah before she started eating
 Muhammad – ate using both of his hands
 Marya – used her right hand while eating
 Who among the four learners practised the correct manners of eating according to the Hadith
 of the Prophet (P.b.u.h)?
 …………………………………………………………………………………………..
 9. The reason why Muslims should brush their teeth according to the Hadith of the Prophet is for
 them to …………………………………………
 10. Muslims emulate and practise the character of the Prophet (P.b.u.h) so as to
 …………………………………………………………………………………………………..
© 2024 The Kenya National Examinations Council
 11. During the IRE lesson, learners were asked to match attributes of Allah with their corresponding
 meaning.
 The attribute that is correctly matched with its meaning as presented by the learners is
 Attribute Meaning
 Al- Samiiu The source of Peace
 Al baswir The All Seeing
 As – Salaam The All Hearing
 12. Israfil is one of the angels of Allah.
 He is in charge of ………………………………………………………...
 13. Learners were watching a video clip on the story of Prophet Nuh building the ark.
 A value that the learners derived from the story is………………………………………
 (Responsibility, Unity, Social Justice)
 14. The attribute of Allah that you could use to remind your classmates that Allah can hear whatever
 is said either in public or private is
 ………………………………………………………………………………………………
 15. One virtue that Muslims learn from the angels of recording good and bad deeds is
 ……………………………………………………………………………………….
 16. While preparing for the IRE lesson, your desk mate Hassan cut his finger with a razor blade as
 he was sharpening his pencil, and the blood stained his shirt.
 How will you advise him to clean the shirt to remove the impurity?
 …………………………………………………………
 17. Which of the following acts will nullify wudhu? …………………………………………
 (Passing wind, talking loudly, absence of water)
 18. One reason why Muslims perform wudhu is to
 (wash away sins, use the available water)
 ………………………………………………………………………………………………..
 19. Salim found his classmate Ahmad praying while dressed in a short sleeved shirt and a pair of
 shorts. He asked his classmate to go and fulfil all the conditions for swalah for his prayer to be
 valid.
 The condition that Ahmad was supposed to fulfil is ………………………………………….
 Turn Over
© 2024 The Kenya National Examinations Council
 20. During an IRE lesson, learners listed some acts that were observed in a practical performance
 demonstration of how to pray.
 i. Pronouncing Takbiratul Ihram
 ii. Recitation of Surah Al Fatiha
 iii. Reciting a Surah after Surah Al Fatiha
 iv. Performing Rukuu
 Which among the acts are pillars of swalah only? …………………………………………
 (i, ii, iii), (ii, iii, iv), (i, iii, iv)
 21. Three learners presented on how they interacted with Allah’s creatures as follows:
 Said – fed a hungry dog
 Isa – watered plants in the school garden
 Saida – carried heavy luggage on a donkey
 Identify the learners who presented the appropriate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s
 creatures?
 …………………………………………………………………………………………………
 22. One reason why Islam is against begging is
 …………………………………………………………………………………………………...
 23. One way Grade 4 learners can use media responsibly is by
 ………………………………………………………………………………………………….
 24. The dua that is recited by a Muslim before leaving the house is
 …………………………………………………………………………………………….
 25. One reason why Muslims should observe Islamic code of dressing is
 …………………………………………………………………………………………………..
 26. Write one obligation of children towards members of the extended family
 …………………………………………………………………………………………………..
 27. While discussing the obligation of children to their parents, teacher Samya emphasized that
 parents should be respected.
 Why is this important in Islam?
 ……………………………………………………………………………………………….
© 2024 The Kenya National Examinations Council
 28. The first person to convert to Islam from among the youth is
 …………………………………………………………………………………………….
 29. A value that Muslims learn from the Prophet’s journey to Taif is ………………………
 (Patience, Respect)
 30. The reason why Khadija is considered a key pillar in the Prophet’s mission is because
 …………………………………………………………………………………………
